tokenizer_rules: Numbers keep comma groups, then commas are removed
Hangul runs and ASCII words of length >= 2
Hangul surface form plus overlapping syllable bigrams when the run is longer than 2
Percent signs are stripped from numeric tokens
No stopword list and no morphological dictionary
Query term frequency is saturated at 1
Documents with score 0 are omitted from top-k

calculation_q07.formula: margin = operating_income / revenue * 100; delta_pp = fy2025_margin - fy2024_margin

metrics.population: one filing, fixed 10-question regression set, not company-wide performance
metrics.answer_complete_definition: Numerator counts supported questions whose required source spans are fully covered. Denominator is only answer_complete_ceiling=true. Partial questions cannot reach a complete answer, so they are outside this denominator.
metrics.source_ceiling_definition: Required source spans are covered. For a partial question this is the document ceiling of the supported claims. It is not a complete answer and it does not measure abstention, because there is no generation layer.

failure_taxonomy_at_5.unit: missed required spans of positive questions
